title: Residual Exact Sequence Splitting
body_html:
Residual Exact Sequence Splitting

For the residual lattice layers in the epipelagic theta setup, there is an exact sequence \[ 0\to Y\to \mathcal W\to X\to 0 \] of finite symplectic spaces. The natural quotient \(P\to J\) splits, and under this splitting the exact sequence splits as a \(J\)-module: \[ \mathcal W\simeq Y\oplus X. \]
proof_html:
Extraction

Appendix 1 gives an explicit apartment model using a basis adapted to the hermitian form. It decomposes \(V\) into fractional jump classes \(V^{[r]}\), constructs a reductive group scheme \(Q\), identifies its special fiber with the finite quotient \(G_L/G_{L,0+}\), and uses the graded subspace \(X_{-1/(2m)}\) to split the quotient map.
